lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd2NiO4 crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Pnma (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 28 atoms (Nd8Ni4O16) distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Nd centers coordinated by eight O neighbors, while Ni centers adopt a tetrahedral environment with four O neighbors; O centers have four geometric neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 28 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Ni tetrahedra and corner-sharing between Nd 8-vertex polyhedra and Ni tetrahedra.
